title: Six AI Employees Run a Launch
title_zh: 六位 AI 员工值守一场发布会
summary: Six AI employee roles cover 77 of the 97 workflows of the 2026-12-17 launch (snapshot 2026-11-25): Donna and Blossom at the front, Community and Auto-X on the countdown, Finance on the demo ledger, HR and Admin on templates; the other 20 workflows stay behind human gates or on the roadmap.
summary_zh: 六个 AI 员工岗位覆盖 2026 年 12 月 17 日发布会 97 项流程中的 77 项（2026-11-25 快照）：Donna 与小花在前台，社群与 Auto-X 推进倒计时，财务员核对演示账本，HR 与行政维护模板；其余 20 项流程留守人工闸门或路线图边界。
subject: https://github.com/the-omega-institute/trureturing
